live slice, ever — a slice's record is public). Only test data goes here:

|---|---|
| `team_field_service_walk.csv` | The founder's test team file of the walk on 2026-10-30 (IMPR-2026-DVTZ38) |
| `complaints_process_finding60.docx` | The founder's flawed SIPOC of finding 60, as a Word file |
| `ap_late_payments_jan_jun_2026.csv` | The run-through's scripted data file (`scripts/define_runthrough.py`) |
